description: Pick an airport on the map, or from the list, to see its observed weather (METARs) over time: flight category, cloud layers, visibility, present weather, wind, temperature and pressure.

panels.title: Airports
panels.description: Each airport with weather data, coloured by the flight category of its latest report in the time range: VFR green, MVFR blue, IFR red, LIFR magenta. The selected airport is the yellow star. Click an airport, then "Show this airport", to see its weather below.

targets.rawSql:
-- Each airport's latest report in the time range, as a flight category.
SELECT a.airport AS airport, a.airport_name AS Name, a.lat AS lat, a.lon AS lon,
       w.category AS `Flight category`, FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%MZ', w.valid) AS `Last report`
FROM (
    SELECT station, valid, CASE WHEN vsby IS NULL AND ceiling IS NULL AND skyc1 = '' THEN NULL
            WHEN ceiling < 500 OR vsby < 1 THEN 'LIFR'
            WHEN ceiling < 1000 OR vsby < 3 THEN 'IFR'
            WHEN ceiling <= 3000 OR vsby <= 5 THEN 'MVFR'
            ELSE 'VFR' END AS category
    FROM (
        SELECT station, r.*, (SELECT MIN(l) FROM UNNEST([
                IF(r.skyc1 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), r.skyl1, NULL), IF(r.skyc2 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), r.skyl2, NULL),
                IF(r.skyc3 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), r.skyl3, NULL), IF(r.skyc4 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), r.skyl4, NULL)]) AS l) AS ceiling
        FROM (
            SELECT station, ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(valid, skyc1, skyc2, skyc3, skyc4, skyl1, skyl2, skyl3, skyl4, vsby)
                                      ORDER BY valid DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS r
            FROM faa.weather WHERE $__timeFilter(valid)
            GROUP BY station
        )
    )
) AS w
INNER JOIN faa.airport_station AS a ON a.station = w.station
SELECT airport, airport_name AS Name, lat, lon FROM faa.airport_station WHERE airport = '${airport}' LIMIT 1

panels.title: Flight category
panels.description: FAA flight category of the latest report in the time range. VFR: ceiling above 3,000 ft and visibility above 5 mi; MVFR: ceiling 1,000-3,000 ft or visibility 3-5 mi; IFR: ceiling 500-999 ft or visibility 1-3 mi; LIFR: ceiling below 500 ft or visibility below 1 mi.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN vsby IS NULL AND ceiling IS NULL AND skyc1 = '' THEN NULL
            WHEN ceiling < 500 OR vsby < 1 THEN 'LIFR'
            WHEN ceiling < 1000 OR vsby < 3 THEN 'IFR'
            WHEN ceiling <= 3000 OR vsby <= 5 THEN 'MVFR'
            ELSE 'VFR' END AS `Flight category`
FROM (SELECT *, (SELECT MIN(l) FROM UNNEST([
                IF(skyc1 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl1, NULL), IF(skyc2 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl2, NULL),
                IF(skyc3 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl3, NULL), IF(skyc4 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl4, NULL)]) AS l) AS ceiling
      FROM faa.weather WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid))
ORDER BY valid DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Wind
panels.description: Latest wind: direction it blows from (degrees true), speed and gusts in knots.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT IF(sknt = 0, 'Calm', CONCAT(IFNULL(LPAD(CAST(CAST(drct AS INT64) AS STRING), 3, '0'), 'VRB'), '° ',
       CAST(CAST(sknt AS INT64) AS STRING), IFNULL(CONCAT('G', CAST(CAST(gust AS INT64) AS STRING)), ''), ' kt')) AS Wind
FROM (SELECT *, (SELECT MIN(l) FROM UNNEST([
                IF(skyc1 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl1, NULL), IF(skyc2 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl2, NULL),
                IF(skyc3 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl3, NULL), IF(skyc4 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl4, NULL)]) AS l) AS ceiling
      FROM faa.weather WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid))
ORDER BY valid DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Visibility
panels.description: Latest visibility, statute miles (10 = 10 or more).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT vsby AS Visibility
FROM (SELECT *, (SELECT MIN(l) FROM UNNEST([
                IF(skyc1 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl1, NULL), IF(skyc2 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl2, NULL),
                IF(skyc3 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl3, NULL), IF(skyc4 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl4, NULL)]) AS l) AS ceiling
      FROM faa.weather WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid))
ORDER BY valid DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Ceiling
panels.description: Lowest broken, overcast or vertical-visibility layer in the latest report, feet above ground.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT IFNULL(CONCAT(CAST(CAST(ceiling AS INT64) AS STRING), ' ft'), 'None') AS Ceiling
FROM (SELECT *, (SELECT MIN(l) FROM UNNEST([
                IF(skyc1 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl1, NULL), IF(skyc2 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl2, NULL),
                IF(skyc3 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl3, NULL), IF(skyc4 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl4, NULL)]) AS l) AS ceiling
      FROM faa.weather WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid))
ORDER BY valid DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Temp / dew point
panels.description: Latest temperature and dew point. A spread of a few degrees or less favours fog and low cloud.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CONCAT(CAST(CAST(ROUND(tmpf) AS INT64) AS STRING), ' / ', CAST(CAST(ROUND(dwpf) AS INT64) AS STRING), ' °F') AS `Temp_dew_point`
FROM (SELECT *, (SELECT MIN(l) FROM UNNEST([
                IF(skyc1 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl1, NULL), IF(skyc2 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl2, NULL),
                IF(skyc3 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl3, NULL), IF(skyc4 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl4, NULL)]) AS l) AS ceiling
      FROM faa.weather WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid))
ORDER BY valid DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Altimeter
panels.description: Latest altimeter setting, inches of mercury.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT alti AS Altimeter
FROM (SELECT *, (SELECT MIN(l) FROM UNNEST([
                IF(skyc1 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl1, NULL), IF(skyc2 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl2, NULL),
                IF(skyc3 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl3, NULL), IF(skyc4 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl4, NULL)]) AS l) AS ceiling
      FROM faa.weather WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid))
ORDER BY valid DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Sky
panels.description: Cloud layers in the latest report, lowest first (– if none): ◔ few (1-2 eighths), ◑ scattered (3-4), ◕ broken (5-7), ● overcast, ⊗ sky obscured (vertical visibility); heights in feet above ground.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NULLIF(ARRAY_TO_STRING([
       CASE WHEN skyc1 IN ('', 'CLR') THEN NULL
            ELSE CONCAT(CASE skyc1 WHEN 'FEW' THEN '◔ FEW' WHEN 'SCT' THEN '◑ SCT' WHEN 'BKN' THEN '◕ BKN'
                                     WHEN 'OVC' THEN '● OVC' WHEN 'VV' THEN '⊗ VV' ELSE skyc1 END,
                        IFNULL(CONCAT(' ', CAST(CAST(skyl1 AS INT64) AS STRING), ' ft'), '')) END,
       CASE WHEN skyc2 IN ('', 'CLR') THEN NULL
            ELSE CONCAT(CASE skyc2 WHEN 'FEW' THEN '◔ FEW' WHEN 'SCT' THEN '◑ SCT' WHEN 'BKN' THEN '◕ BKN'
                                     WHEN 'OVC' THEN '● OVC' WHEN 'VV' THEN '⊗ VV' ELSE skyc2 END,
                        IFNULL(CONCAT(' ', CAST(CAST(skyl2 AS INT64) AS STRING), ' ft'), '')) END,
       CASE WHEN skyc3 IN ('', 'CLR') THEN NULL
            ELSE CONCAT(CASE skyc3 WHEN 'FEW' THEN '◔ FEW' WHEN 'SCT' THEN '◑ SCT' WHEN 'BKN' THEN '◕ BKN'
                                     WHEN 'OVC' THEN '● OVC' WHEN 'VV' THEN '⊗ VV' ELSE skyc3 END,
                        IFNULL(CONCAT(' ', CAST(CAST(skyl3 AS INT64) AS STRING), ' ft'), '')) END,
       CASE WHEN skyc4 IN ('', 'CLR') THEN NULL
            ELSE CONCAT(CASE skyc4 WHEN 'FEW' THEN '◔ FEW' WHEN 'SCT' THEN '◑ SCT' WHEN 'BKN' THEN '◕ BKN'
                                     WHEN 'OVC' THEN '● OVC' WHEN 'VV' THEN '⊗ VV' ELSE skyc4 END,
                        IFNULL(CONCAT(' ', CAST(CAST(skyl4 AS INT64) AS STRING), ' ft'), '')) END], '   '), '') AS Sky
FROM (SELECT *, (SELECT MIN(l) FROM UNNEST([
                IF(skyc1 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl1, NULL), IF(skyc2 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl2, NULL),
                IF(skyc3 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl3, NULL), IF(skyc4 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl4, NULL)]) AS l) AS ceiling
      FROM faa.weather WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid))
ORDER BY valid DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Latest METAR
panels.description: The raw text of the latest report in the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT metar AS `Latest METAR`
FROM (SELECT *, (SELECT MIN(l) FROM UNNEST([

                IF(skyc3 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl3, NULL), IF(skyc4 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl4, NULL)]) AS l) AS ceiling
      FROM faa.weather WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid))
ORDER BY valid DESC LIMIT 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT valid AS time, CASE WHEN vsby IS NULL AND ceiling IS NULL AND skyc1 = '' THEN NULL
            WHEN ceiling < 500 OR vsby < 1 THEN 'LIFR'
            WHEN ceiling < 1000 OR vsby < 3 THEN 'IFR'
            WHEN ceiling <= 3000 OR vsby <= 5 THEN 'MVFR'
            ELSE 'VFR' END AS `Flight category`

panels.title: Cloud layers
panels.description: Each reported cloud layer (skyc1-4 at heights skyl1-4) as a dot at its height in feet above ground, one per report; layer 1 is always the lowest. The scale stops at 35,000 ft: the few higher reports are almost all typing errors in the METAR. Colour shows the cover, cool to warm as it increases: ◔ few (1-2 eighths of the sky) blue, ◑ scattered (3-4) green, ◕ broken (5-7) yellow, ● overcast orange; ⊗ sky obscured purple, with vertical visibility as the height. Clear sky has no layer. The lowest broken, overcast or obscured layer is the ceiling; the bands behind show the flight category it alone would give: LIFR below 500 ft, IFR below 1,000, MVFR to 3,000.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT valid AS time,
       IF(skyc1 = 'FEW', skyl1, NULL) AS `FEW`,
       IF(skyc1 = 'SCT', skyl1, NULL) AS `SCT`,
       IF(skyc1 = 'BKN', skyl1, NULL) AS `BKN`,
       IF(skyc1 = 'OVC', skyl1, NULL) AS `OVC`,
       IF(skyc1 = 'VV', skyl1, NULL) AS `VV`,
       IF(skyc2 = 'FEW', skyl2, NULL) AS `FEW_layer_2`,
       IF(skyc2 = 'SCT', skyl2, NULL) AS `SCT_layer_2`,
       IF(skyc2 = 'BKN', skyl2, NULL) AS `BKN_layer_2`,
       IF(skyc2 = 'OVC', skyl2, NULL) AS `OVC_layer_2`,
       IF(skyc2 = 'VV', skyl2, NULL) AS `VV_layer_2`,
       IF(skyc3 = 'FEW', skyl3, NULL) AS `FEW_layer_3`,
       IF(skyc3 = 'SCT', skyl3, NULL) AS `SCT_layer_3`,
       IF(skyc3 = 'BKN', skyl3, NULL) AS `BKN_layer_3`,
       IF(skyc3 = 'OVC', skyl3, NULL) AS `OVC_layer_3`,
       IF(skyc3 = 'VV', skyl3, NULL) AS `VV_layer_3`,
       IF(skyc4 = 'FEW', skyl4, NULL) AS `FEW_layer_4`,
       IF(skyc4 = 'SCT', skyl4, NULL) AS `SCT_layer_4`,
       IF(skyc4 = 'BKN', skyl4, NULL) AS `BKN_layer_4`,
       IF(skyc4 = 'OVC', skyl4, NULL) AS `OVC_layer_4`,
       IF(skyc4 = 'VV', skyl4, NULL) AS `VV_layer_4`
FROM faa.weather WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Low cloud
panels.description: The same cloud layers below 5,000 ft, where the ceiling decides whether flights operate under visual or instrument rules; higher layers are off the top. Colour shows the cover, cool to warm as it increases: ◔ few (1-2 eighths of the sky) blue, ◑ scattered (3-4) green, ◕ broken (5-7) yellow, ● overcast orange; ⊗ sky obscured purple, with vertical visibility as the height. Clear sky has no layer. The lowest broken, overcast or obscured layer is the ceiling; the bands behind show the flight category it alone would give: LIFR below 500 ft, IFR below 1,000, MVFR to 3,000.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT valid AS time,
       IF(skyc1 = 'FEW', skyl1, NULL) AS `FEW`,
       IF(skyc1 = 'SCT', skyl1, NULL) AS `SCT`,
       IF(skyc1 = 'BKN', skyl1, NULL) AS `BKN`,
       IF(skyc1 = 'OVC', skyl1, NULL) AS `OVC`,
       IF(skyc1 = 'VV', skyl1, NULL) AS `VV`,
       IF(skyc2 = 'FEW', skyl2, NULL) AS `FEW_layer_2`,
       IF(skyc2 = 'SCT', skyl2, NULL) AS `SCT_layer_2`,
       IF(skyc2 = 'BKN', skyl2, NULL) AS `BKN_layer_2`,
       IF(skyc2 = 'OVC', skyl2, NULL) AS `OVC_layer_2`,
       IF(skyc2 = 'VV', skyl2, NULL) AS `VV_layer_2`,
       IF(skyc3 = 'FEW', skyl3, NULL) AS `FEW_layer_3`,
       IF(skyc3 = 'SCT', skyl3, NULL) AS `SCT_layer_3`,
       IF(skyc3 = 'BKN', skyl3, NULL) AS `BKN_layer_3`,

       IF(skyc4 = 'FEW', skyl4, NULL) AS `FEW_layer_4`,

panels.title: Visibility
panels.description: Visibility in statute miles (10 = 10 or more). Bands: below 1 mi LIFR, 1-3 IFR, 3-5 MVFR.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT valid AS time, vsby AS Visibility
FROM faa.weather WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Temperature and dew point
panels.description: Temperature and dew point, °F. Where the lines meet, the air is saturated: expect fog, mist or low cloud. The dotted line is freezing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT valid AS time, tmpf AS Temperature, dwpf AS `Dew point`
FROM faa.weather WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Present weather
panels.description: Most significant weather in each report: ⛈ thunderstorm, 🧊 freezing rain or drizzle, ❄ snow, sleet or hail, 🌧 rain or showers, 🌦 drizzle, 🌫 fog, ≡ mist, haze, smoke or dust. The second row is the METAR code: - light, + heavy, VC in the vicinity, SH showers, BL blowing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT valid AS time,
       CASE WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(wxcodes, r'TS') THEN '⛈ Thunderstorm'
            WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(wxcodes, r'FZ(RA|DZ)') THEN '🧊 Freezing rain'
            WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(wxcodes, r'SN|SG|PL|GS|GR') THEN '❄ Snow / ice'
            WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(wxcodes, r'RA|SH') THEN '🌧 Rain'
            WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(wxcodes, r'DZ') THEN '🌦 Drizzle'
            WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(wxcodes, r'FG') THEN '🌫 Fog'
            WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(wxcodes, r'BR|HZ|FU|DU|SA') THEN '≡ Mist / haze'
            WHEN wxcodes != '' THEN '? Other' END AS Weather,
       NULLIF(wxcodes, '') AS Codes
FROM faa.weather WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Wind direction
panels.description: Arrows point the way the wind blows; the letters say where it blows from (↓ N is a north wind).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT valid AS time,
       CASE WHEN sknt IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN sknt = 0 THEN '○ Calm' WHEN drct IS NULL THEN '↻ Variable'
            ELSE ['↓ N', '↙ NE', '← E', '↖ SE', '↑ S', '↗ SW', '→ W', '↘ NW'][OFFSET(DIV(MOD(CAST(FLOOR(drct + 22.5) AS INT64), 360), 45))]
       END AS `Wind from`
FROM faa.weather WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid) ORDER BY time

SELECT valid AS time, sknt AS Wind, gust AS Gusts
FROM faa.weather WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Precipitation and pressure
panels.description: Precipitation since the last hourly report, inches (bars; a trace shows as 0.0001), and altimeter setting, inHg (line, right axis). A falling altimeter usually means a low and worse weather approaching.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT valid AS time, p01i AS Precipitation, alti AS Altimeter
FROM faa.weather WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Reports (METARs)
panels.description: Every report in the time range, newest first, as transmitted. Routine reports are issued hourly; specials (SPECI) when conditions change.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%MZ', valid) AS `Time_UTC`, CASE WHEN vsby IS NULL AND ceiling IS NULL AND skyc1 = '' THEN NULL
            WHEN ceiling < 500 OR vsby < 1 THEN 'LIFR'
            WHEN ceiling < 1000 OR vsby < 3 THEN 'IFR'
            WHEN ceiling <= 3000 OR vsby <= 5 THEN 'MVFR'
            ELSE 'VFR' END AS `Flight category`, metar AS METAR
FROM (SELECT *, (SELECT MIN(l) FROM UNNEST([
                IF(skyc1 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl1, NULL), IF(skyc2 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl2, NULL),
                IF(skyc3 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl3, NULL), IF(skyc4 IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'), skyl4, NULL)]) AS l) AS ceiling
      FROM faa.weather WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid))
ORDER BY valid DESC LIMIT 2000
